subject: SIG: BCP artifact sampling and live witness schedule
body:
From: SFO Audit Team <sfo-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG - BCP artifact sampling and live witness request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this. For the SIG assessment we need to sample BCP/DR artifacts and schedule two short live-witness slots (recorded) where an operator walks through a restore and a KV cache warm-start. Proposed items:

- Sampling: RTO/RPO matrix, restore runbook excerpt, recent rehearsal logs (last 6 months)
- Witness 1 (restore walkthrough): 45 minutes, runbook-led restore of a non-prod dataset
- Witness 2 (KV warm-start): 30 minutes, show cache population and recovery timing

Can you confirm available dates/times this week or next and list the files you plan to share? We will provide a short evidence checklist once we lock times.

Regards,
SFO Audit Team
--
SFO Audit (ThirdParty Audit Co.)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: SFO Audit Team <sfo-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG - BCP artifact sampling and live witness request

Hi —

Thanks, we can support both requests. Quick answers and next steps:

1) Artifact list we will provide (attached as a packet):
   - redwood_bcp_summary_v1.pdf (overview + org chart for DR holders)
   - rpo_rto_matrix_2027-10-02.xlsx (per-service RTO/RPO)
   - rehearsal_log_2027Q3.csv (high level drill records)
   - restore_runbook_excerpt.pdf (sanitized; steps and playbook owner contact)

2) Proposed live witness windows (PST):
   - Option A: Wed 2027-10-06 09:30–11:00 (restore walkthrough + Q&A)
   - Option B: Thu 2027-10-07 13:00–14:00 (KV warm-start demo)
   - Option C: Fri 2027-10-08 morning if you need a backstop

3) Point people: Marissa will own the restore walkthrough; Ben will run the KV warm-start and speak to cache timings and safety guards. Jordan will be on the call for controls/context.

We will attach a short pre-read and a 3-minute orientation video for the witness session. Please confirm the preferred slots and any additional scope for sampling.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, SFO Audit Team <sfo-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Oct 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Attached: evidence packet and witness prep

Vivek / team —

Attached is the initial evidence packet and a short orientation clip: redwood_bcp_summary_v1.pdf and witness_instructions.mp4. I sanitized any customer-identifying details from the runbook excerpt; if the auditor needs unsanitized records we can provide under the existing NDA and a short list of redaction reasons.

A few clarifications for the witness:
- Restore demo will use an internal non-prod snapshot and a masked dataset. Runbook steps are linear; we expect ~35 minutes for the restore itself and 10–15 minutes for questions.
- KV warm-start demo will include: cold start (measurements) -> demonstrate prefix caching -> a simulated traffic spike to show latency/throughput behavior. Ben has timings in the RTO/RPO sheet.

Attachments: redwood_bcp_summary_v1.pdf (8 pages), rpo_rto_matrix_2027-10-02.xlsx (sheet: service_matrix), witness_instructions.mp4 (2:08)

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Reliability Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: SFO Audit Team <sfo-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Oct 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG - BCP artifact sampling and live witness request

Adding a few technical notes so the auditor has realistic expectations:

- RTO/RPO matrix: our stated RTOs are tiered by product (core inference: RTO 2 hours / RPO 15 minutes; analytics batch: RTO 6 hours / RPO 1 hour). See rpo_rto_matrix_2027-10-02.xlsx.
- Restore demo notes: the runbook includes automated rollback guards and a smoke-test checklist. We will run through the smoke tests live; some steps are scripted to avoid drift.
- KV warm-start: we will show both a full-cold-start and a warm-start from snapshot; for the latter we expect 7–12 minutes to reach steady-state for small-to-medium traffic profiles. We will record timings and share the log extracts.

If you want deeper sampling (e.g., the actual system call logs or raw snapshot files) let us know — those are available but require a limited-access transfer.

-Ben
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tony Li <tony.li@firstbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, SFO Audit Team <sfo-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG - BCP artifact sampling and live witness request

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. We confirm Option A for the restore walkthrough (Wed 2027-10-06 09:30 PST) and Option B for KV the following day (Thu 2027-10-07 13:00 PST). A couple of small asks before the sessions:

- Please upload the sanitized restore runbook excerpt and the rehearsal logs to the shared Drive link by EOD Tue 2027-10-05.
- Provide a short list of personnel who will be on camera during the witness (name + title).
- We may request one additional 15-minute slot to review the RPO/RTO spreadsheet with Ben after the KV demo.

Can someone confirm the Drive upload and attendee list?

Best,
Tony Li
Controls Lead, FirstBank (on behalf of SIG assessment)
